description:
Lineform is the free, native Markdown editor for Mac for people who want focused writing without giving up real files. Write, read, and preview ordinary .md and .txt documents wherever you keep them—Finder, iCloud Drive, Git, or any folder.

WRITE, READ, AND REVIEW
• Write in clean Markdown, then switch between Write, Read, and side-by-side Preview modes.
• Open several documents in tabs, navigate by heading outline, search within and across files, and jump quickly to any document.
• Use familiar Markdown formatting, tables, task lists, callouts, syntax-highlighted code, Mermaid diagrams, and LaTeX math.

MADE FOR LONG-FORM READING
• Tune type size, line height, margins, column width, focus, themes, and contrast.
• Choose dyslexia-friendly Atkinson Hyperlegible or OpenDyslexic reading fonts.
• Read documents aloud with the voices built into macOS.

REAL FILES, NATIVE MACOS
• Work directly with Markdown and plain-text files in Finder, iCloud Drive, Git, or any folder you choose.
• Autosave naturally, preview Markdown in Finder with Quick Look, and export to HTML, PDF, Styled PDF, or Rich Text.
• Run shortcuts to create a note or open a file in Lineform.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, analytics, document upload, or AI.
• Remote images are never downloaded. Spell checking and read-aloud use macOS services on your Mac.

Lineform requires macOS 14 or later.
promotionalText: A calm, native Markdown editor for writing, reading, and reviewing real files on your Mac.
